newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 3c to 619c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 3c to 619c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell three cents to 619 cents a kg clean on Thursday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was mainly cheaper, with 19/20/24 microns 0.5 percent cheaper, 21/22/23m slightly cheaper, and 25m unchanged.
Merino skirtings of 19m were slightly dearer, with 20/21/22m generally unchanged, it said.
In crossbreds, 26m was unchanged, 27m 0.5 percent cheaper, 28m slightly dearer, 29/30m one percent cheaper and 31m one percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged, locks one percent cheaper and crutchings unchanged.
WI said Japanese interests including China were principal buyers with strong support from Western Europe and Taiwan.
Of the 25,959 bales offered, 12 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 109,500 bales to be offered.
